title: The 3 Best Countertop Nugget Ice Makers
h1: The 3 Best Countertop Nugget Ice Makers
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for countertop nugget ice makers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at countertop nugget ice makers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: GE Profile Opal 2.0 Nugget Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 38 lbs of nugget ice per 24 hours, 0.75-gallon side water tank, WiFi with SmartHQ app and voice control.
strengths: Highest output and largest reservoir of any countertop nugget ice maker in this list
The most established brand name in nugget ice machines, with the deepest track record
App-based maintenance alerts make the descale cycle easy to stay on top of
limitations: The most expensive machine in this list by a wide margin
Largest footprint, needs a dedicated counter spot
WiFi features are unnecessary for anyone who just wants ice
features: 38 lbs of nugget ice per 24 hours
WiFi with SmartHQ app and voice control
First batch ready in about 10 minutes

products.name: Euhomy Nugget Ice Maker Countertop
products.blurb: Key specs: Up to 34 lbs of nugget ice per day, First batch ready in about 6 minutes, Self-cleaning cycle.
strengths: Fastest batch cycle in this list at about 6 minutes
34 lbs a day is close to the GE Opal's output at a fraction of the price
Smaller, more portable footprint than the side-tank GE Opal design
limitations: Smaller reservoir than the GE Opal, needs more frequent refilling
No app, scheduling, or voice control features
Shorter market track record and fewer long-term owner reviews
features: Up to 34 lbs of nugget ice per day
First batch ready in about 6 minutes
Removable top cover for cleaning access

products.name: Silonn Countertop Nugget Ice Maker, 44 lb/Day
strengths: Chewable nugget ice at a lower price than premium brands
Timer for ice ready when you need it
limitations: Ice basket is not refrigerated, so ice slowly melts
Daily output depends on room and water temperature
Needs regular descaling with hard water

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
